text:
alex: Quick ask — customer (FinSys Inc) wants a presigned S3 link to our SOC 2 report and a couple of control extracts for a POC. NDA signed but it expires in 7 days. Can we extend or provide a bridge letter? :thinking_face:
emma: Do we know whether NDA allows temporary access to SOC2 artifacts after expiry? If not, legal needs to sign off. Also recommend limiting presigned TTL and IP ranges. :eyes:
jordan: FYI presigned URLs default to 24h in our tooling. We can create one with aws s3 presign and --expires-in. Example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-sec/soc2/2025-report.pdf --expires-in 86400`
emma: Would prefer an extract (controls matrix + sysdesc) rather than full report if legal wants redaction. We can also host a read-only session (Zoom + screen share) as an alternative.
lee: Legal here — we can do either: (1) a short bridge letter confirming access for POC and stating no new findings since report date, or (2) extend NDA term. Bridge letter is faster but needs approval from GC. If customer needs a copy, we require a limited presigned link + watermark and access log.
alex: Customer specifically asked for download-ready PDF. They said their vendor team doesn't accept screen-shares. They also asked how long the presigned link will be valid — want at least 14 days.
jordan: We can set expires-in 1209600 (14 days) when creating presign. But ops prefers <=7 days for sensitive artifacts. Also we can add CloudFront signed cookies for extra control if needed.
emma: Security preference: 7 days max, IP allowlist if customer can provide static IPs. Watermark with recipient name + timestamp helps mitigate sharing. Also keep audit logs and revoke link if NDA lapses.
s3-bot: [automated] generated_presign: s3://redwood-sec/soc2/2025-report.pdf expires_in=604800 created_by=jordan request_id=pr-4821
lee: If we do bridge letter, sample language: "Redwood confirms the SOC 2 Type II report dated MM/DD/YYYY remains accurate as of issuance and access is provided solely for customer evaluation under existing NDA terms; no new unremediated control exceptions have been identified." I'll draft and route for GC approval.
alex: Thanks. Next steps I propose: 1) Offer 7-day presigned link with watermark + IP allowlist if customer can supply, 2) Offer bridge letter template and ask customer whether 7 days is acceptable or they insist on 14, 3) If customer insists on 14, escalate to GC for expedited signoff to issue bridge or NDA extension.
emma: +1. Also note: redact cloud account IDs and internal contact emails from the PDF extract.
jordan: I'll stand by to generate presign once we have recipient info and confirm TTL. Code snippet I'll run: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-sec/soc2/2025-report.pdf --expires-in 604800`
lee: I'll put a draft bridge letter in this thread in ~30m. Also request: please send customer legal contact and intended recipient full name for watermark.
alex: Sending contact now: vendor-team@finsys.com, recipient name "Morgan Patel". I'll ping them for IPs too. :+1:
emma: Noted. We'll redact and prepare extract version as fallback.
lee: Draft posted (see #legal-draft link). If GC approves, we can sign same day.
alex: Great — I'll update customer and await confirmation on 7-day vs 14-day. Thanks all. :pray:
